_comment: Fast-target variant of the C.2 missed-detections scenario, designed to expose the process_noise_q (H2) hypothesis. The slow (0.5 m/s) variant keeps detections so close to predictions that q has no operational effect on gating. Here v=5 m/s gives ~6.7 range_bin of inter-frame motion, so even small velocity-estimate errors or bin-quantization noise produce range residuals large enough that the q-dependent term in the gate denominator (sigma_r2 + cov[0,0]) starts to matter. Run length is shorter (30 frames at 5 m/s = 7.5 m traversal) to fit inside the ~9.6 m unambiguous range axis. Marginal SNR amplitude is kept at 0.0006 so misses still happen at Pd in the 0.5-0.7 band; this preserves the coast-frame regime the sweep is probing.
